ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white) pixel clusters distributed as mottle across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-pixel region dominates the central and proximal fluke area. Distinct high-intensity white pixel blobs are concentrated along the distal margins and extreme lateral tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate pixel-calculated internal angle of 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular trailing edge with high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations; distinct jagged pixel boundaries are visible on the distal segments of both lobes, isolated from the white background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward curve on the upper lobe boundaries transitioning to a slightly concave sweep towards the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white circular pixel clusters observed on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, particularly prominent on the right lobe tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The lateral tips of both lobes exhibit jagged, irregular terminations indicating minor tissue erosion or permanent scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-density white pixel 'splatter' cluster localized on the distal edge of the right lobe margin.
